units.source_text: 戴着眼镜看报的父亲说道，

en.t: My father, wearing glasses and reading the newspaper, said,

units.source_text: 他似乎在沉思默想着自己的病。

en.t: He seemed to be silently brooding over his own illness.

units.source_text: 我也回忆起了不久前，依照往年惯例驾临我们大学毕业典礼的天皇陛下。

en.t: I also recalled His Majesty the Emperor, who had recently attended our university graduation ceremony as he did every year.
